title: User Menu
description: Fiori user menu popover with account header, manage account, menu items and sign out (ui5-user-menu).

usage.summary: Expose signed-in user information, user-specific actions and sign out from the profile entry point.
useWhen: Let users inspect the current account and access settings, legal information or other user-specific actions.
Open the account menu from the shell bar profile entry point without leaving the current page.
Set showManageAccount only when a central profile-management destination exists.

avoidWhen.when: Offer general object or page commands without signed-in user information.
Let users switch between products rather than access their current user settings.
